answer: To counter Sybil attacks, an agent economy can couple identities to photo-electrochemical micro-cells. An agent authenticates by injecting synthetic nectar over an umber iron-oxide photoanode, producing an analog redox response. An attacker attempting to forge valid identities must maintain discrete microfluidic hardware and replenish chemical reagents per node. However, catalytic surface passivation over time drifts response curves, necessitating recalibration.
